reviews.text:
I wanted to thank the grooming team at this salon who carefully trimmed my little dog's nails, as she's very resistant to this kind of treatment 🫣.

They saw me right away and took the time to look after my little Diva 😅 with patience and kindness.
Thank you again, and see you soon! You're wonderful! 🙏
Perfect

The staff are truly friendly and very attentive to the animals. They use quality products and their work is always meticulous. You can entrust your pets to Océane and her mother with complete confidence; they will be pampered and spoiled rotten ;-)
Very professional, kind, and welcoming to animals and their owners.
I only have two things to say: professionalism and empathy, thank you 😊 …
Thank you for your feedback! ☺️
My dog ​​is very difficult, but she has her regular groomer with whom she gets along well, and she goes to 4 pattes feeling confident and calm.

Thanks for the note.
🙂 …

A wonderful discovery!

I had to find a new grooming salon after my local one closed.

I've had some bad experiences in the past.

It was with some trepidation that I dropped off Uschka, my little Shih Tzu with a strong personality.

The welcome was very warm, friendly, and professional.
As a result, the other two are now waiting for their next appointments. Uschka, meanwhile, is all clean and prancing around, proud of her new haircut.
They also have a very wide selection of accessories, beds, etc.
It's a real pleasure to meet people who love our animals.
Thank you for your kindness.
My Pomsky's first grooming session and it was perfect, thank you so much!
Top-notch groomers. You can really see that they love their job and animals. Very patient and kind to my mum's little dog "Iris".

First grooming session for our 10-month-old BAM puppy, and the service was perfect. There was absolutely no anxiety about our puppy; I highly recommend them. (A little treat was included, which immediately took away any stress 😊). …
Super groomer, meticulous work, a pure joy for my dog, I highly recommend her
Thank you so much 😀 …
Thank you so much 😘 …
First time at this salon today for Marty and I'm delighted. The three people who work there are wonderful, friendly, attentive, and very professional. I highly recommend them and thank them again.

Fantastic grooming salon!
My Persian cat's grooming went very well.
The groomer was incredibly gentle and kind; you can tell she loves animals.
Thanks for Romy ;)
The staff were excellent and took great care of my dog. I highly recommend them.
Our friends 🐶🐱 are in good hands with passionate professionals 👍 …

Fantastic! Extremely kind people, ready to do anything to make our furry friends feel comfortable. My cocker spaniel is stubborn and very timid, so very few (if any) groomers will take him, and luckily here we found wonderful people willing to take care of him (and, most importantly, giving him a lot of confidence, since at today's appointment he was hardly scared anymore). He came out all clean and handsome, having had a great time (and happy with some sweet treats).
